text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Watching the Arc de Triomphe on video, I am certain. 
If Duramente had run in it, 
she would have won. As strong as she is--

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
In any case, the Kikuka Sho comes first. 
Duramente seemed a little uneasy about 
how little experience she has at long distances.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
But she means to win. In that case it will be fine. 
When I told her so, she laughed 
and said she was relieved.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
In the Kikuka Sho paddock, Duramente comes face to face 
with Kitasan Black. It felt, she said, 
like standing before a giant.
